confidence_notes: Local price data are limited and not specific to July; the [Tottori cost index](https://citycost.org/tottori/) informs the meal and drink estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use their approximate relationship to beer, checked against [one local menu](https://tabelog.com/tottori/A3101/A310101/31005400/dtlmenu/drink/). Accommodation prices are holistic estimates; July rates and hostel availability are uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Tottori price data and the broader cost level of smaller cities in Japan's Chugoku region.
